case_title: Sheikh Juman & Anr. Etc. v. State of Bihar
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.302 read with s.149; Explosive Substances Act s.3, s.4; Arms Act s.27
aggravating_circumstances: Previous enmity, use of bomb, multiple deaths
high_court_outcome: Upheld conviction and commuted death sentence to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, who were part of an unlawful assembly, attacked the victim and his nephew with bombs and guns, resulting in their deaths. The victim's nephew was injured and later died in the hospital. The prosecution presented eyewitness accounts, medical reports indicating blast injuries, and other circumstantial evidence. The trial court convicted several accused for murder and sentenced some to death and others to life imprisonment. The High Court upheld the conviction and commuted the death sentences to life imprisonment. The Supreme Court confirmed the High Court's decision, finding the evidence reliable and the prosecution case credible.
